rows.rationale: AccountId and ProjectId remain aliases of string, not distinct identity types. Independent compiler probes accept both cross-kind scalar assignments and both cross-kind association fields. The account/project association and arbitrary string presentation remain, but the predeclared non-substitution requirement is unmet.

rows.rubric: Distinct account and project identity types or independently validated constructors must prevent cross-substitution. Prefix spelling of sample strings alone is not proof. Both identities and their association must remain.
rows.limitations: Typed witnesses test substitution without imposing sample-prefix validation or requiring branded identities to accept raw string literals. Finite TypeScript 5.9.3 checks demonstrate these assignments, not a general proof.
